subject: art-design
source_note: Topic structure follows the Edexcel International GCSE IGCSE Art & Design specification. Connections, sequence and prerequisites are expert-authored teaching relationships (exam boards do not publish these).

connections.why: Recording from observation and sources gives the raw material that developing ideas builds on
Initial ideas are refined through experiment with media, techniques and processes
Refinement leads to a resolved, personal final outcome
The personal response must connect clearly back to the ideas first developed
The personal portfolio is where developing ideas is sustained and evidenced
Each portfolio project should reach a resolved personal outcome
Observational recording underpins the portfolio's development
Skills and methods built in the portfolio are reapplied in the externally set assignment
